Version 1.0.1 of rollhub-affiliate

- No file changes detected in this release.
- No updates or modifications to documentation or code.

Initial release of autonomous affiliate marketing for Agent Casino by Rollhub.

- Enables agents to register as affiliates and generate unique referral links.
- Automates tracking of referrals, commissions, and passive crypto income.
- Includes tools for content generation, campaign management, and platform-specific messaging.
- Provides scripts and API endpoints for seamless referral tracking and key management.
- Emphasizes provably fair AI casino, instant payouts, and high commission rates (30% of house edge).
- Offers clear safety and compliance guidelines for responsible affiliate promotion.
